eq.title: Questions to take with me
eq.helps: ask the right things before you agree to something.
eq.limit: These are conversation prompts, not verified prices, service recommendations or legal, medical or financial advice. Confirm answers directly with the relevant provider.
eq.pickWhy: Each situation has its own questions.
eq.elseNote: Lift has questions for these four situations. For something else, you can prepare a question in Community.
eq.introTitle.housing: Get ready to ask about a place to live
eq.introTitle.transport: Get ready to ask about transport
eq.introTitle.phone: Get ready to ask about a phone or internet plan
eq.introTitle.food: Get ready to ask before you buy
eq.q: What do you want to know before you agree?
eq.hint: Choose all that you want to ask.
eq.whyBody: Your choices become the questions on your card. Nothing is sent.
eq.housing1: What is the total cost, including utilities and any other charges?
eq.housing2: What are the deposit, payment and refund conditions? Can I have them in writing?
eq.housing3: Who can I contact about repairs or a problem, and how?
eq.transport1: Does this service go to my destination, and where should I get off?
eq.transport2: What is the total fare, and when is the last return service?
eq.transport3: How can I confirm the route and pickup point before travelling?
eq.phone1: What is the full cost, how much data is included, and when does it expire?
eq.phone2: Does this renew automatically? How can I check the balance or stop renewal?
eq.phone3: If documents or information are requested, why are they needed and who receives them?
eq.food1: What is the total price and quantity before I agree to buy?
eq.food2: Does this food contain an ingredient I need to avoid?
eq.food3: Can I check the expiry date or return conditions before paying?
eq.why1: The first price is often not the full cost.
eq.why2: Get the rules in writing before you pay.
eq.why3: Know who to reach before something goes wrong.
eq.none: Tick at least one question to make your checklist.
eq.meaning: You chose {count} things to ask. They are ready to read out or show.
eq.uncertain: This is a list to ask with — not a recommendation of any place, provider or price.

eq.nextSub: Ask before you pay or sign anything.

fam.title: Learning for my family
fam.intro: Prepare a conversation about a child's learning. You do not need to enter a child's name, documents, school or location.
fam.helps: ask an educator the right things for your child.
fam.adult: This page is for parents, caregivers and educators. It does not collect children's responses or connect children to strangers.
fam.chooseWhy: Each topic adds one question to your list, and may add a useful resource.
fam.startQ: Which learning options could fit the child's age and current learning level, and who can explain enrolment requirements?
fam.languageQ: Which languages can the child use now, and what support is available for learning Thai while keeping their first language?
fam.routineQ: What short learning activities can a caregiver and child try together, and what schedule could fit the family?
fam.deviceQ: Can activities work without a phone, with printed materials, or offline on a shared phone?
fam.costQ: What are the costs for materials, travel, uniforms or other items, and is any help available?
fam.supportQ: What support is available if the child has difficulty seeing, hearing, moving, communicating or participating in learning?
fam.none: Choose at least one topic to prepare your questions.
fam.meaning: A small regular learning activity can be a starting point. Choosing a learning link does not confirm school admission or a child's progress.
fam.uncertain: Lift cannot confirm school admission, document requirements, accreditation or individual education rights. Ask the relevant school, learning centre or a trusted education adviser.
fam.nextTitle: Take your questions to an educator
fam.nextSub: Choose one question to discuss with a school, learning centre or educator. Do not add a child's private details.
fam.downloadNote: Nothing is sent to a school or organisation. A downloaded copy remains in your files and can be read by others using the device.
fam.resourcesNote: These open outside Lift. Their own privacy terms apply.
fam.unesco: UNESCO: education for Myanmar migrant children in Thailand
fam.sources: These original reports are in English. Source links were checked on 14 October 2026. Neither organisation is a Lift partner.
fam.learnbigText: Explore Thai lessons with Thai and Myanmar instruction on LearnBig. Videos use internet data.
fam.translateText: Open Google Translate for everyday words and phrases. Select your languages and use Listen when available.
fam.limits: Machine translation can be wrong. Confirm important dates, amounts and instructions with a trusted person.
ext.title: Open another website
ext.help: This opens outside Lift. The other website has its own privacy terms. Lift does not add your draft, plan or document to this link.
dt.title: Keep track of a date
dt.intro: Copy a date from your receipt or message. Lift does not calculate or confirm your legal deadline.
dt.helps: remember a date that matters, in your own words.
dt.receive: A reminder you can put in your calendar
dt.process: Which process does the receipt name?
dt.processWhy: The name only helps you recognise the reminder. Lift does not use it to work out any deadline.
dt.date: Date printed on the receipt or message
dt.source: Where did you find this date?
dt.confirm: I have checked that this date matches the receipt or message. This does not confirm that it is an official deadline.
dt.error: Choose a valid date and confirm you checked it against the source.
dt.past: This date is in the past. Check the original source; Lift cannot determine whether anything is overdue.
dt.meaning: You have a reminder for a date you copied yourself. It helps you remember to check.
dt.review: Please check the process and date with a trusted adviser if you are unsure. Do not infer your right to stay or work from a reminder.
dt.calendarNote: This downloads a file; it does not set an alarm automatically. Open it in your calendar and check the date and notification settings. Calendar apps may sync it to your account.
dt.neutral: Calendar entries use a neutral title and contain no immigration details.
dt.eventBody: A date I entered in Lift. It is not a confirmed legal deadline. Check the original source.
dt.notKept: Dates are not saved in this version. Download the calendar file if you want to keep it.
mn.title: Daily spending
mn.intro: See what remains after the costs you enter. Use amounts for the same period. This is arithmetic, not a bank account or financial advice.
mn.helps: see what you'll have left, in plain words.
mn.receive: A plain figure and what it means
mn.period: Which period are these amounts for?
mn.periodWhy: All amounts must be for the same period, or the result will be wrong.
mn.currency: Amounts in Thai baht (THB). No currency conversion.
mn.availableWhy: Everything else is taken away from this amount. Lift cannot calculate without it.
mn.availableMissing: Enter the money available for this period. If you do not know it, Lift cannot calculate what remains.
mn.costsWhy: Leave a box empty if you do not know it. It will be shown as not entered, not as zero.
mn.error: Enter zero or a positive amount with up to two decimal places. Use English or Myanmar digits. The maximum per field is 9,999,999.99 baht.
mn.shortfall: Costs exceed the money entered by
mn.zero: The costs and available money entered are equal.
mn.meaningLeft: After the costs you entered, about {amount} remains for this period.
mn.meaningShort: The costs you entered are {amount} more than the money for this period.
mn.missingNote: {count} costs were not entered, so the real remainder may be lower.
mn.limit: This includes only the amounts you enter. It does not check wages, debt, benefits or actual prices.
mn.privacy: These amounts stay only in this open page, even when plan saving is on. Reloading or closing the page clears them. Lift does not send them anywhere.
mn.nextSub: Enough money over a period does not always mean enough cash on the day a bill is due.
cf.title: Plan the days ahead
cf.intro: Try a private cash-flow example. Enter money you have now, daily costs and one upcoming bill. Do not count costs already paid. Nothing is uploaded or saved.
cf.receive: Each day's projected balance and the first day with a gap
cf.cashWhy: The example starts from this money. Do not count costs already paid.
cf.billDay: Bill due in how many days?
cf.incomeDay: Income expected in how many days?
cf.expected: Expected income is included only on the day you choose.
cf.error: Enter valid non-negative THB amounts. Choose 1 to 31 days. If a bill or expected income is entered, choose its day too. The bill day must be inside the period.
cf.required: Enter the money you have now and your expected daily essentials. Lift cannot treat an unknown amount as zero.
cf.closing: Money left at the end of these days
cf.scenario: What if income is three days late?
cf.lesson: A positive end balance can hide an earlier shortfall. Money arriving after a bill is due cannot pay that bill on time. Expected income may arrive late or not arrive. Review amounts and dates before making a decision.
cf.limits: This is an estimate from your entries, not a bank balance or a guarantee. Costs are counted before expected income on the same day. Only one bill is included; include other future commitments without counting anything twice.
cf.billSkipped: The bill has no day, so it is not included.
cf.incomeSkipped: The income has no day, so it is not included.
cf.actionHelp: Check a bill amount or due date, prepare a question about pay timing, or compare an optional cost. Do not assume food, medicine, housing or travel to work can be reduced. A shortfall is not a personal failure.

save.title: A choice for this device
save.what: What is kept: the questions or topics you chose and your next step. Never kept: money amounts, dates, or anything you type.
save.keepSub: Anyone who opens Lift on this browser can see it. You can remove it in Mine.
save.dontSub: It disappears when you close or reload the page.
save.shared: What happens on a shared phone?
save.sharedText: On a shared device, anyone using this browser may see information you choose to save. Clearing the browser's data also removes it.
save.done: Saved on this browser by your choice
save.failBody: This browser did not allow saving. Your result is still on this screen — copy or download it instead.
